courseCitationVerification.scope: Only cited page text and retained targeted audit read; no full 911-page medical-content review. Original PDF/images are not distributed.

M06.01.note: Respiratory rate is contextual; impedance estimation and its limits are approved supplemental explanation, not a modeled monitor signal.

M06.02.note: Saturation, hemoglobin concentration, total oxygen content and delivery remain distinct. No pulse-oximeter or light-absorption simulation is claimed.

M06.03.note: Approved correction: pp91/93 give 94–99% and NOT 100%; the narration does not treat 100% as automatically abnormal or proof of oxygen toxicity. Device/skin-pigmentation and carbon-monoxide limits remain contextual.

M06.04.note: Existing synthetic capnogram only: dead-space, mixing, plateau and end-tidal point are named clock holds; preset 40 mmHg is independent of mechanics, not measured CO₂ or a prediction. No CPR/treatment thresholds are included.

M06.05.note: Each monitoring method answers a different question. Existing synthetic capnography is explicit; other signals are explanation cards. No assessment/treatment algorithm is implied.
